notes: Multiplayer painting on surfaces is Coloring & Drawing, which the Party & Casual notes claim as one of the genre's own Roblox subgenres, and those notes decide stage B outright: this is not a bare UI surface heading for P5 because the drawing happens in a real room, so the room is built as a SET — nothing has to be reachable, since play is a raycast from the mouse onto a wall rather than traversal, and there is no gap to jump anywhere in a 40x40 box. Shape is interior-single, taken from outside the genre's typical pair, because the author confirmed a closed four-wall room with a floor and no larger area: that row is the only one that says there is no exterior to generate, where space-bounded would be equally satisfied by a fenced outdoor playground and invite one. No Party & Casual preset applies — Coloring & Drawing is named in the notes but is not one of the three presets — so preset is none. Deciding without a user: the brush, ten-colour picker, size slider and eraser are all tool UI with no geometry, and the requested playground dressing has no option row, so it rides as room dressing on walls and floor the author asked to keep plain and clearly paintable; no option was chosen at all, which the skill treats as a legitimate simple map.
